response.overview: A common not-really-skilled thief robs one of the most valuable diamonds in the world, which inexplicably it's sitting in a random typical accross-the-board spanish household. Two problematic detectives will try to solve this stupid grounded run-of-the-mill, yet still extraordinary, mistery. They obviously need to investigate it above the law, with no agency involve. And so, they will deploy their most offensive weaponry to complete their mission, putting nothing on the line.
response.tagline: Back on the street... They're the Eye of the Tiger: it's all for the thrill of the fight.
response.title: El Robo de la Joya
